commit.subject: LU-20290 idl: Temporarily reserve OBD_CONNECT2_IRNID_REPLACE
commit.message:
LU-20290 idl: Temporarily reserve OBD_CONNECT2_IRNID_REPLACE

Reserve OBD_CONNECT2_IRNID_REPLACE flag value
0x10000000000000ULL for servicenode discovery.

Add placeholder entries for connect flags not yet present in this
branch to preserve the correct flag-name table indexing.

This is a temporary copy of the upstream flag reservation,
needed until the corresponding changes are merged into master.
It can be dropped once the upstream reservation is available.

Test-Parameters: trivial

Signed-off-by: Serguei Smirnov <ssmirnov@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: Id96df4a7f7d5613b7336c82e5d45f8e8d2233bb2
